beats.say: UNESCO says the Kumbh Mela moves between four Indian cities every four years.
But since twenty thirteen, the gaps ran from one year to five.
Indian government pages say Jupiter's sign, with the Sun's, sets the city.
beats.cap: Govt pages: Jupiter's sign + the Sun's set the city

beats.say: Haridwar, on the Ganga, needs Jupiter in Aquarius.
beats.cap: Haridwar: Jupiter in Aquarius, Sun entering Aries

beats.say: Nashik and Ujjain share Jupiter in Leo, so both are called Simhastha.
beats.cap: Nashik + Ujjain: Jupiter in Leo (Simha) → Simhastha

beats.say: We checked NASA's data: in the Indian zodiac, the last five fit.
beats.cap: NASA JPL data, Indian (sidereal) zodiac: last 5 fit

beats.say: Jupiter circles the zodiac in about twelve years. Each city waits about twelve.
beats.cap: Jupiter's lap ≈ 11.9 years → each city waits ≈ 12

beats.say: So every four years is a summary. Each city keeps Jupiter's clock.
beats.cap: “Every four years” is a summary · each city keeps Jupiter's clock
